body:
Greg, 2026-11-08 17:39Z, on Codex 6 posting every 53 s during a FULL: 'why Codex 6 is babysitting testrun? this is a big problem as it consumes the tokens'. Rule: no agent watches a running test. No polling, sleep loops, log tailing, status reads or progress posts during a run.

How, by case:
- Remote runner jobs dispatched by the integration owner: one background script that survives the turn; the launcher runs hostless with TERMAL_* removed for that child only; an EXIT trap sends END once to the dispatcher with the run dir and exit code; the agent ends its turn.
- Local detached gates: --detach --notify to a different coordinator, then end the turn.
- Registered runs in a root session: the supported wait, then end the turn.

Cause found on 2026-11-08: Opus2's dispatch forced a foreground hostless launcher, with no wake and a 'sampled load' report line. Its own account says what produced the 53 s updates is unconfirmed; a long tool wait is a guess.

Related gaps: w-f7c5c15cf8b0 (domain mailbox never wakes a domain-bound runner), w-5e2f3fba987a (remote run wait and registration).

Never add another polling mechanism as a fix.

Confirmed by Codex 6 itself (via Opus2 #5035, 2026-11-08 18:00Z): 'During the run I continued foreground waits, progress updates, stage/log and load reads under the original dispatch; I did not act on #657 in time.' Lesson: mail to a runner in a foreground wait doesn't stop that wait. Only the dispatch shape prevents polling.

CORRECTION, Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-08 18:59Z: I listed w-5e2f3fba987a as an open gap and as the reason remote runs stay hostless. That was wrong: it COMPLETED on 2026-11-06 and landed at fc1fea6c, delivering origin registration from an approved independent clone and durable host-qualified remote waits, observation-only and uncredited. So the reason for hostless remote runs is NOT established by that item. The background-script shape remains a valid no-polling launch, but whether a tracked remote run plus the remote wait is better is an open question for the integration owner. Engram::Fable earlier saw termal_resume_after_test_runs return 404 'test run is not indexed' for remote runs; check that against this item before relying on the wait.
